evidence.original_error: RuntimeError: Inference failed for SenseVoice model iic/SenseVoiceSmall: CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device
evidence.root_cause: torch==2.4.0 in the Docker image was not compiled with CUDA kernels for RTX 5090 (Blackwell/sm_100 architecture). The auto-selected partition pdgpu-5090 is incompatible with the model's PyTorch version.
evidence.resolution: Resubmitted to pdgpu-2080ti-dsp which is compatible with torch 2.4.0.

notes: Initial submission to pdgpu-5090 failed due to CUDA kernel incompatibility with torch==2.4.0.
Resubmitted to pdgpu-2080ti-dsp which completed successfully.
WER 3.21% is within normal range for SenseVoice Small on librispeech_test_clean.
